texts.li: [theirLowtech] {X_nameFull} is touring the region. Twenty years ago {X_nameDef} was a village healer; now there are songs about {X_objective}, and people walk for days to be treated. {X_nameDef} is in {PLACE} this week and will move on soon.\n\nThey say {X_nameDef} once gave a man back a hand he had lost, and cured a fever no other healer could name. In {PLACE}, people start queuing at {X_possessive} door before dawn.

[theirHightech] {X_nameFull}, the surgeon, is touring the region with a van full of equipment and a long waiting list. {X_nameDef} is in {PLACE} this week and will move on soon.\n\nPeople say {X_nameDef} has rebuilt hands that were lost and cured patients other doctors had given up on, though some of the stories are probably exaggerated.

[theirLowtech] Word has come from {PLACE} that {X_nameFull}, the famous healer, is staying there this week. In the villages they say {X_nameDef} once set a man's broken back and he walked home, and that {X_pronoun} can tell which fever a patient has by the smell of the room.\n\nPeople are walking to {PLACE} from three valleys away. {X_nameDef} won't stay long.

summaries.li: {X_nameDef} could be invited to the colony for a day, to treat {A_nameDef} and teach the colony's own doctor. It costs silver, and the chance won't come again soon.
[invited] {X_nameDef} is on the way to the colony.

texts.li: [!remembered] {X_nameDef}'s assistant has sent word that the healer could stop at the colony on the way to the next town, for {COUNT} silver. {A_nameDef} has lived with {A_possessive} condition a long time, and {X_nameDef} might be able to do something about it.\n\n{B_nameDef} would give a lot to watch {X_nameDef} work.

[remembered] {X_nameDef} has heard how the colony helped {FACTION} when times were hard, and has sent word: the healer will stop at the colony on the way to the next town, for {COUNT} silver, half what others pay. {A_nameDef} has lived with {A_possessive} condition a long time.\n\n{B_nameDef} would give a lot to watch {X_nameDef} work.

li.label: Invite {X_objective} ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: The assistant's rider takes the fee back to {PLACE}. {X_nameDef} will come within a few days.

li.label: Not now
li.outcome: The colony sends its regrets. {X_nameDef} will be gone from the region soon.

texts.li: [!nothingToMend,taught] {X_nameDef} has come to the colony and treated {A_nameDef}, after a long look without a word and a call for hot water and the colony's best light. {ITEM}\n\n{B_nameDef} watched every step and asked a lot of questions, and {X_nameDef} answered most of them.
[!nothingToMend,!taught] {X_nameDef} has come to the colony and treated {A_nameDef}, after a long look without a word and a call for hot water and the colony's best light. {ITEM}
[nothingToMend] {X_nameDef} has come to the colony and looked {A_nameDef} over carefully, twice, then said there was nothing left for a healer to do. {X_nameDef} has given the colony its silver back.
[!nothingToMend] {X_nameDef} has left the colony for the next town, with the colony's silver and its thanks.
[nothingToMend] {X_nameDef} has left the colony for the next town. Whatever ailed {A_nameDef} had healed on its own before the healer came.

li.chronicle: {X_nameDef}, the famous healer, came to the colony.

texts.li: {X_nameDef} has left the region, and the crowds that followed the healer from town to town have gone home. In the towns they are already arguing over which of the cures really happened.
{X_nameDef} has gone on out of the region, and the crowd at the healer's door has gone home. People will be telling stories about {X_objective} for years.

li.chronicle: {X_nameDef}, the famous healer, passed through the region.

texts.li: Every few years the region's herds migrate together, and this is one of those years. Large herds are crossing the area, and hunters from {FACTION} have come out of {PLACE} to hunt them.\n\nThere is plenty of game, but the herds and the hunters are a danger to anyone in their way.

[fall] The herds are moving south together before the cold comes. Their dust can be seen from the colony a day before the animals arrive, and hunters from {FACTION} are already camped in the valleys around {PLACE}.

[spring] The herds are coming back north with the new grass, more of them than anyone has seen in years. Hunters from {FACTION} have come out of {PLACE} to meet them, as their winter stores are nearly gone.

summaries.li: Herds pass the colony far more often, and rare beasts with them. {FACTION}'s hunters may ask to hunt on the colony's land.

texts.li: A party of hunters from {PLACE} has asked to follow the herds across the colony's land. They will keep clear of the fields and the buildings, they say. They would pay {COUNT} silver for the right, or take it as a favor between neighbors.\n\n{A_nameDef} thinks they know what they're doing.

Hunters from {PLACE} have followed the herds to the edge of the colony's land, and stopped there to ask. They want leave to cross it and to take what they kill. They'll pay {COUNT} silver, or take it as a neighbor's favor.\n\n{A_nameDef} has had a look at them, and says they know their business.

li.label: Let them hunt
li.outcome: The party thanks the colony and goes after the herds. For days afterward their horns can be heard at dawn.

li.label: Let them hunt, for {COUNT} silver
li.outcome: Their headman pays without arguing, and the party goes after the herds.
li.deed: charged {FACTION}'s hunters to cross its land

li.label: Keep them off the land
li.outcome: The hunters are told to go around the colony's land, and they do.

texts.li: [allowed] The herds have passed, and the hunters of {FACTION} have gone home with full packs. Their horn-blower sounded three long notes as they passed the colony, which among hunters means thanks.
[!allowed] The herds have passed, and the land around the colony is quiet again: trampled in places, greener in others. They'll be back in a few years.

li.chronicle: The great herds passed through the region.

texts.li: Strange beasts from the far country have come into the region, and nobody knows what drove them here. The old hunters of {FACTION} know them only from stories. They move in loose bands and eat anything green.\n\nSome are harmless and some are dangerous. The hunters of {PLACE} are staying close to home until they know which are which.

[winter] The cold has driven strange beasts from the far country down from the high ground. Nobody in {PLACE} has a name for them, and they move in loose bands through the snow.\n\nYesterday one of them stood at the edge of {PLACE}'s fields all day, watching the houses, and then walked away.

Beasts from the far country are crossing the region's hills in loose bands. The old hunters of {FACTION} knew them only from stories. They eat everything green and frighten the herds.\n\nAt {PLACE} the children are no longer allowed out past the fences.

summaries.li: Strange creatures turn up far more often, with herds behind them. A skilled handler may try to tame one, though it may bolt before they get close.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} found tracks by the water today that don't match anything in the colony's books, and has been out sketching them since.

{A_nameDef} came back from the far fields with a drawing of a footprint as wide as {A_possessive} hand, with four claws where there should be three, and wants to know what kind of animal stands on its toes like that.
The strange beasts have gone back toward the far country, or wherever they came from. The hunters of {FACTION} are out on the hills again, and they have plenty of stories about this season.
The strange beasts have gone back into the far country. {FACTION}'s people are out on the hills again, and every one of them has a story about the one that came close.

li.chronicle: The strange herds left the region.

texts.li: The ley lines are restless. Mages in {PLACE} report spells going wrong or turning out far stronger than they meant, and on clear nights the sky is streaked with strange colors.\n\n{FACTION} have shut their mage towers until it passes. Anyone with magical talent will feel it.

[winter] Strange things are happening on the winter nights. The sky over the region glows green and violet after dark, mages in {PLACE} wake to find frost on the inside of their windows, and {FACTION} have shut their mage towers until it passes.\n\nEvery mage in the region is sleeping badly and having the same dreams.

Mages all over the region had the same dream last night, and in {PLACE} the candles burned blue until morning. The ley lines are stirring, and {FACTION} have shut their mage towers until it passes.\n\nAnyone in the colony with magical talent has already felt it.

summaries.li: Shards fall from the sky more often. The colony's mages can study the surge and learn a great deal in a few weeks, but it is risky.

texts.li: Since the sky changed, {A_nameDef} has hardly slept, and now wants to spend the next few nights studying the surge.\n\nThe mages of {PLACE} say a week of it could teach as much as a year of study, but that it can also go badly.

{A_nameDef} has drawn the colors of the night sky on every scrap of paper in the colony, and wants to spend the next few nights studying the surge.\n\nThe mages at {PLACE} say a week of it could teach as much as a year of study. They also say it can go very wrong.

li.label: Let {A_objective} study it
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} sits up studying the surge and fills a notebook with diagrams that nobody else can follow.
li.riskOutcome: Something {A_nameDef} saw while studying the surge has shaken {A_objective}, and {A_nameDef} won't talk about it. The notebook is full, though.

li.label: Not this time
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} stays at the colony, and spends the nights at the window watching the sky.

texts.li: The sky has gone back to its usual colors, and the mages of {PLACE} have opened their towers again. Whatever stirred the ley lines has gone still, and the mages are already arguing about what it was.
The colors have gone out of the night sky, and the shared dreams have stopped. At {PLACE} the mage towers are open again, and every mage in the region has a different account of what happened.

li.chronicle: A season of wild magic passed.
